rules: When a story has metadata.executionSkill set, you MUST invoke that skill (e.g. /copy-component) with data.copyComponentInput as the intake contract. Do NOT implement the work manually — the skill contains critical extraction logic (computed styles, design token mapping, responsive diffing) that cannot be replicated ad-hoc.

For copy-component stories: read .agents/skills/copy-component/SKILL.md first, then invoke the skill with the exact copyComponentInput payload. The skill will handle Playwright extraction, token mapping, schema creation, and React component generation.
qualityGates: cd apps/strapi && pnpm generate:types (when schema changes)

stories.title: Migrate example section
stories.description: Use /copy-component skill to extract, map, and generate this section. The skill handles Playwright-based style extraction, design token mapping, Strapi schema creation, populate config, and React component generation. Pass data.copyComponentInput as the skill's intake contract.
acceptanceCriteria: /copy-component skill was invoked with data.copyComponentInput — do NOT implement manually
Computed styles were extracted via browser_evaluate (not guessed from screenshots)
All CSS values are mapped to design tokens from packages/design-system/src/theme.css
cd apps/strapi && pnpm generate:types passes when schema changes are made
Source and local section screenshots are captured and compared
Text uses Typography; links/images use Strapi utility wrappers
No duplicate UID or duplicate ContentComponents mapping
